ASTA V3 RESULT TRACKING

Upload this file to:
.github/workflows/track-results.yml

The repository already contains:
- scripts/track_results.py
- data/prediction_history.json
- the V3 dashboard files

After uploading:
1. Open GitHub Actions.
2. Open "Track Asta V3 results".
3. Run it manually once.
4. If successful, it will also run every 6 hours.
5. It resolves predictions only when completed results exist in historical_matches.json.

Do not create V4.
